source.text: Ἰδὼν δὲ τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος· καὶ καθίσαντος αὐτοῦ προσῆλθαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then the crowds he went up into the mountain; and having sat down of him came to him the disciples of him;

en.L: And seeing the crowds, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went up on the mountain, and when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had sat down, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}},
en.B: Seeing the crowds, Jesus went up onto the mountain. He sat down, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Jesus saw the crowds of people, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went up on a hill and sat down. His followers came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y viendo a las multitudes, subió al monte, y cuando se hubo sentado, se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos,
es.B: Al ver a las multitudes, Jesús subió al monte. Se sentó, y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron.
es.R: Jesús vio a toda la gente, así que subió a una colina y se sentó. Sus seguidores se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron.

fr.L: Et voyant les foules, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} monta sur la montagne, et quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se fut assis, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples s’approchèrent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}},
fr.B: Voyant les foules, Jésus monta sur la montagne. Il s’assit, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples vinrent auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Jésus a vu les foules, alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est monté sur une colline et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est assis. Ses disciples sont venus près de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Basi akiyaona makundi ya watu, alipanda juu mlimani, na alipokuwa ameketi, wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakamwendea,
sw.B: Yesu alipoyaona makundi ya watu, alipanda mlimani. Akaketi, nao wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakaja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.R: Yesu aliona umati wa watu, basi akapanda juu ya kilima, akaketi. Wafuasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakaja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 무리를 보시고 산에 올라가셨다. 그리고 그분이 앉으시자, 그분의 제자들이 그분께 나아왔다.
ko.B: 예수께서 무리를 보시고 산에 올라가셨다. 예수께서 앉으시자 제자들이 그분께 나아왔다.
ko.R: 예수께서 많은 사람들을 보시고 언덕에 올라가 앉으셨다. 그러자 제자들이 예수께 다가왔다.

vi.L: Thấy đoàn dân đông, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên núi; và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ngồi xuống, các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Thấy đoàn dân đông, Đức Giê-xu lên núi. Ngài ngồi xuống, và các môn đồ đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu thấy đoàn người đông đúc, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên một ngọn đồi và ngồi xuống. Các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: E, vendo as multidões, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} subiu ao monte; e, tendo {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se sentado, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos vieram até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}},
pt.B: Ao ver as multidões, Jesus subiu ao monte. Ele se sentou, e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos se aproximaram {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.R: Jesus viu a multidão de gente e por isso subiu um monte e se sentou. Os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores foram até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

decisions.choice: went up on the mountain: perhaps an echo of Moses on Sinai
alternatives: only a place where the crowd could hear
decisions.reason: Moses went up the mountain to receive the law (Exodus 19:3). Here Jesus goes up a mountain and teaches what the law means (5:17-48). Matthew does not name the mountain or draw the comparison.

decisions.choice: sat down: the posture of a teacher
decisions.reason: Jewish teachers sat to teach (23:2; Luke 4:20).

decisions.choice: his disciples, with the crowds also listening
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to his disciples, but at the end the crowds are amazed at his teaching (7:28-29).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: A new section begins here, so Balanced and Readable name Jesus.

decisions.choice: followers
decisions.reason: Readable says what disciples are.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); the sermon itself is speech and keeps the tenses of speech at every level
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 1-4 and the other Gospels: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken. What Jesus says in the sermon is in the tenses of speech ("on a persécuté les prophètes", 5:12).

decisions.choice: ses disciples at Readable too
decisions.reason: English Readable says "followers". The term sheet keeps "les disciples" at every level, as Mark and Luke do; French "disciple" is a common word for someone who learns from a master.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives (wake, kwake)
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns for Jesus inside the verb (alipanda, wakamwendea), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so only free pronouns and possessives carry the span; this passage has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: "môn đồ" at every level, Readable included
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "followers"; the style guide keeps "môn đồ" for disciples at every level, since the word is plain enough in Vietnamese and recurs through the Gospels.

decisions.choice: "제자들" at every level
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark and John, "제자들" is kept at every level, Readable included; it is plain Korean.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 5
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters; respect for Jesus is carried by "께서", "그분" and -시- at every level (docs/korean-style.md section 7).

decisions.choice: o monte (L, B); um monte (R)
decisions.reason: "Monte" is the ordinary Portuguese word for a hill or mountain in a story like this, and keeps the echo of Moses on the mount (m1). "Morro" is everyday Brazilian but too colloquial for a scene the meaning note links to Sinai.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change; pronouns for Jesus and for God are written plainly through the sermon.

decisions.choice: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ (his disciples) at every level, Readable included
alternatives: ተከታዮቹ (his followers, as the English Readable)
decisions.reason: "ደቀ መዛሙርት" is the everyday Amharic word for a teacher's disciples and is understood by young readers, so it stays at every level. "ተማሪዎች" suggests a school; "ተከታዮች" could include the crowd.

am.L: አፉንም ከፍቶ እንዲህ እያለ ያስተምራቸው ነበር፦

decisions.choice: opening his mouth: a solemn way to begin an important speech
decisions.reason: The phrase marks what follows as weighty teaching (compare Job 3:1; Acts 8:35).

decisions.choice: began to teach them
alternatives: opened his mouth and taught them
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures the teaching under way. Balanced and Readable say he began, and leave out the idiom, which the meaning note explains.

source.text: Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the poor in the spirit, for of them is the kingdom of the heavens.

en.L: "Blessed [are] the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.
en.B: "Blessed are those who are poor in spirit: the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
en.R: "Blessed are those who know they are poor and need God. The kingdom of heaven belongs to them.

es.L: «Dichosos los pobres en espíritu, porque suyo es el reino de los cielos.
es.B: «Dichosos los que son pobres en espíritu: el reino de los cielos es de ellos.
es.R: «Felices los que saben que son pobres y necesitan a Dios. El reino de los cielos les pertenece.

fr.L: « Heureux les pauvres en esprit, car à eux est le royaume des cieux.
fr.B: « Heureux ceux qui sont pauvres en esprit : le royaume des cieux leur appartient.
fr.R: « Ils sont heureux, ceux qui savent qu’ils sont pauvres et qu’ils ont besoin de Dieu. Le royaume des cieux est à eux.

sw.L: "Heri walio maskini rohoni, kwa kuwa wao ndio wenye ufalme wa mbinguni.
sw.B: "Heri wale walio maskini rohoni: ufalme wa mbinguni ni mali yao.
sw.R: "Wamebarikiwa wale wanaojua kwamba ni maskini na wanamhitaji Mungu. Ufalme wa mbinguni ni mali yao.

ko.L: "복이 있다, 심령이 가난한 사람들은. 천국이 그들의 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: "복이 있다, 심령이 가난한 사람들! 천국이 그들의 것이다.
ko.R: "자기가 가난하여 하나님이 꼭 필요하다는 것을 아는 사람들은 복이 있다. 천국은 그들의 것이다.

vi.L: "Phước cho những người nghèo khó trong tâm linh, vì vương quốc thiên đàng là của họ.
vi.B: "Phước cho những ai có tâm linh nghèo khó, vì vương quốc thiên đàng là của họ.
vi.R: "Phước cho những ai biết mình nghèo thiếu và cần đến Đức Chúa Trời, vì vương quốc thiên đàng thuộc về họ.

pt.L: "Bem-aventurados os pobres em espírito, porque deles é o Reino dos céus.
pt.B: "Bem-aventurados os que são pobres em espírito: o Reino dos céus é deles.
pt.R: "Felizes as pessoas que sabem que são pobres e precisam de Deus. O Reino dos céus pertence a elas.

am.L: «የተባረኩ ናቸው በመንፈስ ድሆች የሆኑ፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና።
am.B: «በመንፈስ ድሆች የሆኑ የተባረኩ ናቸው፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናት።
am.R: «ድሆች መሆናቸውንና እግዚአብሔርን እንደሚፈልጉ የሚያውቁ የተባረኩ ናቸው። የሰማይ መንግሥት የእነርሱ ናት።

decisions.choice: blessed: in the happy state of those God favors
alternatives: may they be blessed, as a wish
decisions.reason: The word describes people who are well off in God's eyes, whatever they feel. Each saying states a fact about them and gives the reason in what God will do. The form is known from the Psalms and Proverbs (Psalm 1:1; 32:1).

decisions.choice: poor in spirit: those who know they have nothing to offer God and depend on him
decisions.reason: In the Psalms and Isaiah the poor are the humble who look to God for help (Psalm 34:7, 19; Isaiah 61:1; 66:2). "In spirit" makes clear that an inner poverty is meant, though Jesus's hearers included many who were poor in fact.

decisions.choice: theirs is the kingdom: the first and last sayings promise the kingdom now
decisions.reason: The first saying and the eighth (5:10) both have "is"; the six between have "will". The kingdom frames the list, and its blessings are both present and to come.

decisions.choice: Blessed are ...: the promise after a colon
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps each saying in two halves, the blessing and the promise, and lets the colon stand for the Greek "for". Literal keeps "for".

decisions.choice: those who know they are poor and need God
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase.

decisions.choice: Dichosos (L, B); Felices (R)
decisions.reason: "Dichoso" is the everyday Spanish word for someone in a happy, favored state (meaning decision m1); "bienaventurado" is the older church word and sounds remote to many readers. Readable uses the plainest word, "feliz". Each level keeps one word through all the sayings.

decisions.choice: el reino de los cielos
decisions.reason: The book-wide Spanish wording for Matthew's phrase at every level, keeping his plural "cielos".

decisions.choice: Heureux (L, B); Ils sont heureux, ceux qui ... (R), for all the beatitudes (5:3-11)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 6:20: "heureux" is the usual French word for the beatitudes and says the happy state of those God favours (m1); "bienheureux" now sounds churchly or suggests the blessed in heaven, and "béni" belongs to another Greek word. Readable turns the exclamation, which has no verb, into a plain sentence; Luke's Readable says "Vous êtes heureux" because Luke's sayings are in the second person.

decisions.choice: Heri (L, B); Wamebarikiwa (R)
decisions.reason: "Heri" is the settled Swahili word for the state of those God favors (meaning decision m1). Readable says "wamebarikiwa" (they are blessed), a plain verb new readers know; "wana furaha" would say only that they feel happy.

decisions.choice: ufalme wa mbinguni
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for Matthew's phrase at every level.

decisions.choice: "Phước cho" for "Blessed", at every level
decisions.reason: "Phước cho" is the form Vietnamese readers know (John 20:29) and says that God's favour rests on them, as the meaning decision explains; "hạnh phúc" would name only a feeling. Literal needs no bracket, since the phrase has no verb to supply.

decisions.choice: "vì" before the promise at Balanced, where the English Balanced has a colon
decisions.reason: Vietnamese readers expect the reason word here, and "vì" is light enough to keep the rhythm of the sayings; the same through 5:10.

decisions.choice: "복이 있다" for "blessed", through the Beatitudes
decisions.reason: "복이 있다" says that God's favor rests on these people, as the meaning decision explains, and it is the phrase of the Korean John 13:17. "행복하다" would make it a feeling.

decisions.choice: "복이 있다" first, then the people (L, B), in all the Beatitudes; Readable uses the ordinary Korean order
decisions.reason: Each Greek saying begins with "blessed"; Korean can put the predicate first in an exclamation, which keeps the repeated opening the hearers hear eight times. Balanced gives the promise as a sentence of its own, as the English gives it after a colon.

decisions.choice: "심령이 가난한" (L, B); "자기가 가난하여 하나님이 꼭 필요하다는 것을 아는" (R)
decisions.reason: "심령" is the inner self before God, so the phrase speaks of the spirit's poverty, as the meaning decision explains (those who know they have nothing to offer God). "마음이 가난한" can sound like meanness of heart to new readers; Readable says the meaning.

decisions.choice: Bem-aventurados (L, B); Felizes (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book. "Bem-aventurado" is the Portuguese word for the state m1 describes, favoured by God, and the one Brazilian readers know these sayings by; "abençoado" says that someone has received a blessing, which is narrower. Readable says "Felizes", the plain word, as the English Readable keeps the saying short; it loses some of the sense of God's favour, which the meaning note keeps.

decisions.choice: o Reino dos céus
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Matthew's phrase keeps its plural "céus", as Portuguese has always said it, at every level, as the English keeps "kingdom of heaven" at Readable. "Reino" takes a capital, as in Brazilian usage for the kingdom of God.

decisions.choice: የተባረኩ (blessed)
decisions.reason: The Greek word describes the state of those God favors, not a feeling. "ደስተኞች" would make it a mood. "ብፁዓን" is the familiar church word but is Ge'ez and opaque to many readers; "የተባረኩ" is plain modern Amharic and says that God has blessed them. Literal keeps the Greek order, the word first.

decisions.choice: መንግሥተ ሰማያት (L, B); የሰማይ መንግሥት (R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:2: the church form of Matthew's phrase at Literal and Balanced, its everyday Amharic form at Readable, and Matthew's own wording kept throughout the sermon.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the mourning, for they will be comforted.

en.L: Blessed [are] those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
en.B: Blessed are those who mourn: they will be comforted.
en.R: Blessed are those who are sad and grieving. God will comfort them.

es.L: Dichosos los que están de duelo, porque ellos serán consolados.
es.B: Dichosos los que están de luto: recibirán consuelo.
es.R: Felices los que están tristes y sufren por una pérdida. Dios los consolará.

fr.L: Heureux ceux qui pleurent, car ils seront consolés.
fr.B: Heureux ceux qui sont en deuil : ils recevront la consolation.
fr.R: Ils sont heureux, ceux qui sont tristes et en deuil. Dieu les consolera.

sw.L: Heri wanaoomboleza, kwa kuwa wao watafarijiwa.
sw.R: Wamebarikiwa wale walio na huzuni na wanaoomboleza. Mungu atawafariji.

ko.L: 복이 있다, 슬퍼하는 사람들은. 그들이 위로를 받을 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 복이 있다, 슬퍼하는 사람들! 그들은 위로를 받을 것이다.
ko.R: 슬퍼하며 우는 사람들은 복이 있다. 하나님께서 그들을 위로해 주실 것이다.

vi.L: Phước cho những người than khóc, vì họ sẽ được an ủi.
vi.B: Phước cho những ai đang than khóc, vì họ sẽ được an ủi.
vi.R: Phước cho những ai đang buồn rầu và than khóc, vì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ an ủi họ.

pt.L: Bem-aventurados os que choram, porque eles serão consolados.
pt.B: Bem-aventurados os que choram: eles serão consolados.
pt.R: Felizes as pessoas que estão tristes e de luto. Deus vai consolá-las.

am.R: የሚያዝኑና የሚያለቅሱ የተባረኩ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔር ያጽናናቸዋል።

decisions.choice: those who mourn ... will be comforted: an echo of Isaiah 61:2
alternatives: grief of any kind with no echo
decisions.reason: Isaiah 61:1-3 promises good news to the poor and comfort to all who mourn, the mourners of Zion. Jesus's words recall that promise; the mourning includes grief over sin and over the state of God's people.

decisions.choice: will be comforted: God is the one who will do it
decisions.reason: Jewish speech often used the passive to speak of what God does without naming him. Readable names God.

decisions.choice: Blessed are ...: the promise after a colon
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps each saying in two halves, the blessing and the promise, and lets the colon stand for the Greek "for". Literal keeps "for".

decisions.choice: God will comfort them
decisions.reason: Readable names God, as the passive implies.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ πραεῖς, ὅτι αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσι τὴν γῆν.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the meek, for they will inherit the earth.

en.L: Blessed [are] the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
en.B: Blessed are the gentle: they will inherit the earth.
en.R: Blessed are those who are gentle and humble. God will give them the earth as their own.

es.L: Dichosos los mansos, porque ellos heredarán la tierra.
es.B: Dichosos los apacibles: heredarán la tierra.
es.R: Felices los que son amables y humildes. Dios les dará la tierra como suya.

fr.L: Heureux les doux, car ils hériteront la terre.
fr.B: Heureux ceux qui sont doux : la terre leur sera donnée en héritage.
fr.R: Ils sont heureux, ceux qui sont doux et humbles. Dieu leur donnera la terre pour qu’elle soit à eux.

sw.L: Heri wapole, kwa kuwa wao watairithi dunia.
sw.R: Wamebarikiwa wale walio wapole na wanyenyekevu. Mungu atawapa dunia iwe mali yao.

ko.L: 복이 있다, 온유한 사람들은. 그들이 땅을 물려받을 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 복이 있다, 온유한 사람들! 그들은 땅을 물려받을 것이다.
ko.R: 부드럽고 겸손한 사람들은 복이 있다. 하나님께서 그들에게 땅을 주셔서 그들의 것이 되게 하실 것이다.

vi.L: Phước cho những người hiền lành, vì họ sẽ thừa hưởng trái đất.
vi.B: Phước cho những ai hiền lành, vì họ sẽ thừa hưởng trái đất.
vi.R: Phước cho những ai hiền lành và khiêm nhường, vì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban trái đất cho họ làm cơ nghiệp.

pt.L: Bem-aventurados os mansos, porque eles herdarão a terra.
pt.B: Bem-aventurados os mansos: eles herdarão a terra.
pt.R: Felizes as pessoas que são gentis e humildes. Deus vai dar a elas a terra como herança.

am.L: የተባረኩ ናቸው የዋሆች፤ እነርሱ ምድርን ይወርሳሉና።
am.R: ገሮችና ትሑታን የተባረኩ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔር ምድርን ርስት አድርጎ ይሰጣቸዋል።

decisions.choice: the meek will inherit the earth: Psalm 37:11
decisions.reason: Psalm 37:11 says that the meek will inherit the land. There the land is Israel's promised land; Jesus widens it to the whole earth renewed (19:28).

decisions.choice: meek: gentle and humble, not grasping or violent
decisions.reason: The word describes those who do not push for their own way and leave their cause with God. Jesus uses it of himself (11:29; 21:5).

decisions.choice: the earth
decisions.reason: The same word means land or earth. In the psalm it is the land; here, in a saying addressed to all disciples, the wider sense fits.

decisions.choice: Blessed are ...: the promise after a colon
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps each saying in two halves, the blessing and the promise, and lets the colon stand for the Greek "for". Literal keeps "for".

decisions.choice: gentle (B); gentle and humble (R)
decisions.reason: "Meek" can now suggest weakness. Balanced and Readable use words for the quality meant.

decisions.choice: dunia
decisions.reason: The word can mean the land of Israel, as in Psalm 37:11, or the whole earth (meaning decision m3); "dunia" follows the English "the earth", while "nchi" would point to a country.

decisions.choice: "thừa hưởng trái đất" (L, B); "ban trái đất cho họ làm cơ nghiệp" (R)
decisions.reason: "Đất" alone could mean soil or a plot of land; "trái đất" is the earth. "Cơ nghiệp" (inheritance) at Readable keeps the sense of a gift passed on, as in Psalm 37:11.

decisions.choice: "온유한" (L, B); "부드럽고 겸손한" (R)
decisions.reason: "온유" is gentle strength that does not grasp or strike back (meaning decision); Readable spells it out in two everyday words.

decisions.choice: os mansos
decisions.reason: The English Balanced leaves "meek" because it suggests weakness. Portuguese "manso" does not: it means gentle and calm, and is the word for this quality, so Balanced keeps it. Readable says "gentis e humildes", as the English Readable does.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην, ὅτι αὐτοὶ χορτασθήσονται.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the hungering and thirsting [for] the righteousness, for they will be filled.

en.L: Blessed [are] those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
en.B: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness: they will be satisfied.
en.R: Blessed are those who long for righteousness the way a hungry person longs for food and a thirsty person for water. God will give them all they long for.

es.L: Dichosos los que padecen hambre y sed de la justicia, porque ellos quedarán saciados.
es.B: Dichosos los hambrientos y sedientos de justicia: serán saciados.
es.R: Felices los que desean la justicia como un hambriento desea la comida y un sediento desea el agua. Dios les dará todo lo que desean.

fr.L: Heureux ceux qui ont faim et qui ont soif de la justice, car eux seront rassasiés.
fr.B: Heureux ceux qui ont faim et soif de justice : ils seront comblés.
fr.R: Ils sont heureux, ceux qui désirent la justice autant qu’une personne affamée désire manger et qu’une personne assoiffée désire boire. Dieu leur donnera tout ce qu’ils désirent.

sw.L: Heri wanaoona njaa na kiu ya haki, kwa kuwa wao watashibishwa.
sw.B: Heri wale wanaoona njaa na kiu ya haki: watatoshelezwa.
sw.R: Wamebarikiwa wale wanaotamani haki kama mtu mwenye njaa anavyotamani chakula, na mwenye kiu anavyotamani maji. Mungu atawapa yote wanayoyatamani.

ko.L: 복이 있다, 의에 굶주리고 목마른 사람들은. 그들이 배부르게 될 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 복이 있다, 의에 굶주리고 목마른 사람들! 그들은 배부르게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 배고픈 사람이 음식을 바라고 목마른 사람이 물을 바라듯이, 의를 간절히 바라는 사람들은 복이 있다. 하나님께서 그들이 바라는 것을 다 채워 주실 것이다.

vi.L: Phước cho những người đói khát sự công chính, vì họ sẽ được no đủ.
vi.B: Phước cho những ai đói khát sự công chính, vì họ sẽ được thỏa lòng.
vi.R: Phước cho những ai mong ước sự công chính, như người đói mong có thức ăn và người khát mong có nước uống. Đức Chúa Trời sẽ cho họ được thỏa lòng.

pt.L: Bem-aventurados os que têm fome e sede da justiça, porque eles serão saciados.
pt.B: Bem-aventurados os que têm fome e sede de justiça: eles serão saciados.
pt.R: Felizes as pessoas que desejam a justiça como quem tem fome deseja comida e quem tem sede deseja água. Deus vai dar a elas tudo o que desejam.

am.L: የተባረኩ ናቸው ጽድቅን የሚራቡና የሚጠሙ፤ እነርሱ ይጠግባሉና።
am.B: ጽድቅን የሚራቡና የሚጠሙ የተባረኩ ናቸው፤ ይረካሉ።
am.R: የተራበ ሰው ምግብን፣ የተጠማም ሰው ውኃን እንደሚናፍቅ ጽድቅን የሚናፍቁ የተባረኩ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔር የሚናፍቁትን ሁሉ ይሰጣቸዋል።

decisions.choice: righteousness: right living before God, and God setting things right
decisions.reason: In Matthew righteousness is doing God's will (5:10, 20; 6:1, 33). Those who long for it want to live rightly and want God's justice in the world. Both are in view.

decisions.choice: will be filled: God is the one who will do it
decisions.reason: Jewish speech often used the passive to speak of what God does without naming him. Readable names God.

decisions.choice: Blessed are ...: the promise after a colon
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps each saying in two halves, the blessing and the promise, and lets the colon stand for the Greek "for". Literal keeps "for".

decisions.choice: the way a hungry person longs for food; God will give them all they long for
alternatives: hunger and thirst for; will be filled
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture and names God.

decisions.choice: "sự công chính" for righteousness, at every level
decisions.reason: The key term, as in 3:15 and the Vietnamese Romans; the same in 5:10 and 5:20.

decisions.choice: "의" at every level, in 5:6, 5:10 and 5:20
decisions.reason: "의" is a key term and keeps the same word at every level (docs/korean-style.md section 6); the meaning decision gives its double sense.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ ἐλεήμονες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἐλεηθήσονται.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

en.L: Blessed [are] the merciful, for they will receive mercy.
en.B: Blessed are the merciful: mercy will be shown to them.
en.R: Blessed are those who show mercy to others. God will show mercy to them.

es.L: Dichosos los misericordiosos, porque ellos recibirán misericordia.
es.B: Dichosos los misericordiosos: se les mostrará misericordia.
es.R: Felices los que muestran misericordia a los demás. Dios les mostrará misericordia a ellos.

fr.L: Heureux les miséricordieux, car ils recevront miséricorde.
fr.B: Heureux les miséricordieux : il leur sera fait miséricorde.
fr.R: Ils sont heureux, ceux qui ont pitié des autres. Dieu aura pitié d’eux.

sw.L: Heri wenye huruma, kwa kuwa wao watahurumiwa.
sw.R: Wamebarikiwa wale wanaowahurumia wengine. Mungu atawahurumia.

ko.L: 복이 있다, 자비로운 사람들은. 그들이 자비를 받을 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 복이 있다, 자비로운 사람들! 그들은 자비를 입을 것이다.
ko.R: 다른 사람에게 자비를 베푸는 사람들은 복이 있다. 하나님께서 그들에게 자비를 베푸실 것이다.

vi.L: Phước cho những người có lòng thương xót, vì họ sẽ được thương xót.
vi.B: Phước cho những ai có lòng thương xót, vì họ sẽ được thương xót.
vi.R: Phước cho những ai biết thương xót người khác, vì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ thương xót họ.

pt.L: Bem-aventurados os misericordiosos, porque eles alcançarão misericórdia.
pt.B: Bem-aventurados os misericordiosos: a eles será mostrada misericórdia.
pt.R: Felizes as pessoas que têm misericórdia dos outros. Deus vai ter misericórdia delas.

am.L: የተባረኩ ናቸው መሐሪዎች፤ እነርሱ ምሕረትን ያገኛሉና።
am.R: ለሌሎች ምሕረት የሚያደርጉ የተባረኩ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔርም ምሕረት ያደርግላቸዋል።

decisions.choice: the merciful will receive mercy: from God, at the judgment
decisions.reason: Matthew links mercy given and mercy received (6:12, 14-15; 18:33). The passive points to God.

decisions.choice: Blessed are ...: the promise after a colon
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps each saying in two halves, the blessing and the promise, and lets the colon stand for the Greek "for". Literal keeps "for".

decisions.choice: God will show mercy to them
decisions.reason: Readable names God, as the passive implies.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ καθαροὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ, ὅτι αὐτοὶ τὸν θεὸν ὄψονται.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the pure in the heart, for they the God will see.

en.L: Blessed [are] the pure in heart, for they will see God.
en.B: Blessed are the pure in heart: they will see God.
en.R: Blessed are those whose hearts are pure. They will see God.

es.L: Dichosos los puros de corazón, porque ellos verán a Dios.
es.B: Dichosos los puros de corazón: verán a Dios.
es.R: Felices los que tienen un corazón puro. Ellos verán a Dios.

fr.L: Heureux les purs de cœur, car ils verront Dieu.
fr.B: Heureux les cœurs purs : ils verront Dieu.
fr.R: Ils sont heureux, ceux dont le cœur est pur. Ils verront Dieu.

sw.L: Heri walio safi moyoni, kwa kuwa wao watamwona Mungu.
sw.B: Heri wenye mioyo safi: watamwona Mungu.
sw.R: Wamebarikiwa wale wenye mioyo safi. Watamwona Mungu.

ko.L: 복이 있다, 마음이 깨끗한 사람들은. 그들이 하나님을 볼 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 복이 있다, 마음이 깨끗한 사람들! 그들은 하나님을 뵐 것이다.
ko.R: 마음이 깨끗한 사람들은 복이 있다. 그들은 하나님을 뵙게 될 것이다.

vi.L: Phước cho những người trong sạch trong lòng, vì họ sẽ thấy Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Phước cho những ai có lòng trong sạch, vì họ sẽ thấy Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Phước cho những ai có tấm lòng trong sạch, vì họ sẽ được thấy Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: Bem-aventurados os puros de coração, porque eles verão a Deus.
pt.B: Bem-aventurados os puros de coração: eles verão a Deus.
pt.R: Felizes as pessoas que têm o coração puro. Elas verão a Deus.

am.L: የተባረኩ ናቸው በልብ ንጹሓን የሆኑ፤ እነርሱ እግዚአብሔርን ያያሉና።
am.B: ልባቸው ንጹሕ የሆነ የተባረኩ ናቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርን ያያሉ።
am.R: ልባቸው ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰዎች የተባረኩ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔርን ያያሉ።

decisions.choice: pure in heart: undivided in devotion to God (Psalm 24:3-4)
decisions.reason: Psalm 24 asks who may stand in God's presence and answers: those with clean hands and a pure heart. The heart is the whole inner person.

decisions.choice: will see God: be in his presence
decisions.reason: Seeing God is the hope of being with him (Psalm 17:15; Revelation 22:4).

decisions.choice: Blessed are ...: the promise after a colon
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps each saying in two halves, the blessing and the promise, and lets the colon stand for the Greek "for". Literal keeps "for".

decisions.choice: "뵙다" (B, R) for seeing God; "보다" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean has a humble verb for seeing someone greater; Balanced and Readable use it of God, Literal keeps the plain verb of the Greek.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ εἰρηνοποιοί, ὅτι αὐτοὶ υἱοὶ θεοῦ κληθήσονται.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the peacemakers, for they sons of God will be called.

en.L: Blessed [are] the peacemakers, for they will be called {{gender:children|sons}} of God.
en.B: Blessed are those who make peace: they will be called {{gender:children|sons}} of God.
en.R: Blessed are those who work to bring peace. God will call them {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} {{gender:children|sons}}.

es.L: Dichosos los que hacen la paz, porque ellos serán llamados hijos de Dios.
es.B: Dichosos los que construyen la paz: serán llamados hijos de Dios.
es.R: Felices los que trabajan para traer la paz. Dios los llamará {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hijos.

fr.L: Heureux les artisans de paix, car ils seront appelés {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu.
fr.B: Heureux ceux qui font la paix : ils seront appelés {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu.
fr.R: Ils sont heureux, ceux qui travaillent à faire la paix. Dieu les appellera {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} {{gender:enfants|fils}}.

sw.L: Heri wanaoleta amani, kwa kuwa wao wataitwa wana wa Mungu.
sw.B: Heri wale wanaoleta amani: wataitwa wana wa Mungu.
sw.R: Wamebarikiwa wale wanaojitahidi kuleta amani. Mungu atawaita watoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

ko.L: 복이 있다, 평화를 이루는 사람들은. 그들이 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들이라고 불릴 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 복이 있다, 평화를 이루는 사람들! 그들은 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들이라고 불릴 것이다.
ko.R: 사람들 사이에 평화를 이루려고 애쓰는 사람들은 복이 있다. 하나님께서 그들을 자기의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들이라고 부르실 것이다.

vi.L: Phước cho những người tạo hòa bình, vì họ sẽ được gọi là con cái Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Phước cho những ai đem lại hòa bình, vì họ sẽ được gọi là con cái Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Phước cho những ai cố gắng giúp người ta sống hòa thuận với nhau, vì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ gọi họ là con cái của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Bem-aventurados os pacificadores, porque eles serão chamados filhos de Deus.
pt.B: Bem-aventurados os que promovem a paz: eles serão chamados filhos de Deus.
pt.R: Felizes as pessoas que trabalham para trazer a paz. Deus vai chamá-las de {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} filhos.

am.L: የተባረኩ ናቸው ሰላምን የሚያደርጉ፤ እነርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ይባላሉና።
am.B: ሰላምን የሚያወርዱ የተባረኩ ናቸው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ይባላሉ።
am.R: ሰላም ለማምጣት የሚተጉ የተባረኩ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔር ልጆቹ ብሎ ይጠራቸዋል።

decisions.choice: peacemakers: those who make peace between people
decisions.reason: The word is active: people who bring about peace where there is quarrel and hatred (5:23-24, 44).

decisions.choice: called sons of God: God will own them as his children
decisions.reason: "Son of" describes likeness and belonging; those who make peace are like the God of peace (5:45). The word includes all of them, men and women.

decisions.choice: Blessed are ...: the promise after a colon
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps each saying in two halves, the blessing and the promise, and lets the colon stand for the Greek "for". Literal keeps "for".

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The inclusive default says who is meant; the traditional form keeps "sons".

decisions.choice: hijos, no gender setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already means children, daughters and sons, as "hermanos" includes sisters (meaning decision m2), so it has no second wording for the English gender setting.

decisions.choice: wana (L, B); watoto (R); no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Wana" means children, daughters and sons alike (meaning decision m2), so Swahili has no second wording for the English gender setting.

decisions.choice: "con cái" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Con cái" (children) is how Vietnamese says it; "con trai" would sound like a family's boys, not a title, so Vietnamese has no traditional form to offer as the alternative (style guide, section 7). The same in 5:45.

decisions.choice: "tạo hòa bình" (L); "đem lại hòa bình" (B); "giúp người ta sống hòa thuận" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision speaks of making peace between people, which Vietnamese calls "hòa bình" or "hòa thuận"; the key term "bình an" is kept for the peace God gives.

decisions.choice: {{gender:자녀|아들}}들
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "sons" but means all whom God owns as his children (meaning decision); Korean has two ways of saying it, so the span gives the inclusive word by default and the traditional one as the alternative, the form settled for Matthew; the plural ending "들" stands outside the span so that one particle fits both.

decisions.choice: "평화를 이루는 사람들"
decisions.reason: "평안" is the key term for peace as a gift and state (John 14:27); making peace between people is "평화를 이루다" in Korean, which the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: filhos, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "children" and "sons". Portuguese "filhos" already means sons and daughters together, as it does in everyday speech ("eles têm três filhos"), so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች (children of God), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The ordinary Amharic plural "ልጆች" is what the Greek word means here, and "ወንዶች ልጆች" (male children) is not a traditional wording a reader would want back, so there is no second wording for the setting.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ δεδιωγμένοι ἕνεκεν δικαιοσύνης, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the having been persecuted on account of righteousness, for of them is the kingdom of the heavens.

en.L: Blessed [are] those who have been persecuted for the sake of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.
en.B: Blessed are those who suffer persecution for the sake of righteousness: the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
en.R: Blessed are those who are treated badly because they do what is righteous. The kingdom of heaven belongs to them.

es.L: Dichosos los que han sido perseguidos por causa de la justicia, porque suyo es el reino de los cielos.
es.B: Dichosos los que sufren persecución por causa de la justicia: el reino de los cielos es de ellos.
es.R: Felices los que son maltratados por hacer lo que es justo. El reino de los cielos les pertenece.

fr.L: Heureux ceux qui ont été persécutés à cause de la justice, car à eux est le royaume des cieux.
fr.B: Heureux ceux qui sont persécutés pour la cause de la justice : le royaume des cieux leur appartient.
fr.R: Ils sont heureux, ceux qu’on maltraite parce qu’ils font ce qui est juste. Le royaume des cieux est à eux.

sw.L: Heri wale walioteswa kwa ajili ya haki, kwa kuwa wao ndio wenye ufalme wa mbinguni.
sw.B: Heri wale wanaoteswa kwa sababu ya haki: ufalme wa mbinguni ni mali yao.
sw.R: Wamebarikiwa wale wanaotendewa vibaya kwa sababu wanafanya yaliyo haki. Ufalme wa mbinguni ni mali yao.

ko.L: 복이 있다, 의 때문에 박해를 받은 사람들은. 천국이 그들의 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 복이 있다, 의를 위하여 박해를 받는 사람들! 천국이 그들의 것이다.
ko.R: 의를 행하다가 괴롭힘을 당하는 사람들은 복이 있다. 천국은 그들의 것이다.

vi.L: Phước cho những người đã bị bắt bớ vì sự công chính, vì vương quốc thiên đàng là của họ.
vi.B: Phước cho những ai bị bắt bớ vì sự công chính, vì vương quốc thiên đàng là của họ.
vi.R: Phước cho những ai bị người ta đối xử tệ vì họ làm điều công chính, vì vương quốc thiên đàng thuộc về họ.

pt.L: Bem-aventurados os que têm sido perseguidos por causa da justiça, porque deles é o Reino dos céus.
pt.B: Bem-aventurados os que sofrem perseguição por causa da justiça: o Reino dos céus é deles.
pt.R: Felizes as pessoas que são maltratadas porque fazem o que é justo. O Reino dos céus pertence a elas.

am.L: የተባረኩ ናቸው ስለ ጽድቅ የተሳደዱ፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና።
am.B: ስለ ጽድቅ የሚሳደዱ የተባረኩ ናቸው፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናት።
am.R: ትክክል የሆነውን ስለሚያደርጉ መከራ የሚደርስባቸው የተባረኩ ናቸው። የሰማይ መንግሥት የእነርሱ ናት።

decisions.choice: for the sake of righteousness: because they do what God requires
decisions.reason: They suffer for living rightly, as in 5:6. The next saying makes the cause Jesus himself (5:11).

decisions.choice: theirs is the kingdom: the same promise as the first saying
decisions.reason: The repetition closes the eight sayings (see 5:3).

decisions.choice: Blessed are ...: the promise after a colon
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps each saying in two halves, the blessing and the promise, and lets the colon stand for the Greek "for". Literal keeps "for".

decisions.choice: ትክክል የሆነውን ስለሚያደርጉ (because they do what is right, R); ስለ ጽድቅ (L, B)
decisions.reason: "ጽድቅ" is the key word and stays at Literal and Balanced. The sense here is doing what God requires, so Readable says that plainly, as the English Readable does.

source.text: μακάριοί ἐστε ὅταν ὀνειδίσωσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ διώξωσιν καὶ εἴπωσιν πᾶν πονηρὸν καθ’ ὑμῶν ψευδόμενοι ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed are you when they insult you and persecute and say every evil against you lying on account of me.

en.L: Blessed are you when they insult you and persecute [you] and say every evil [thing] against you, lying, because of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: You are blessed when people abuse you and persecute you and spread all sorts of evil lies about you for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sake.
en.R: You are blessed when people say bad things about you and hurt you and tell lies about you because you follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Dichosos {{plural_you:son|sois}} cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} insulten y [{{plural_you:los|os}}] persigan y digan todo mal contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, mintiendo, por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Dichosos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando la gente {{plural_you:los|os}} insulte, {{plural_you:los|os}} persiga y difunda toda clase de mentiras malvadas contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: Felices {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando la gente hable mal de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} haga daño y diga mentiras sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} por ser seguidores {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}.

fr.L: Heureux êtes-vous quand on vous insultera, et [vous] persécutera, et dira contre vous toute sorte de mal en mentant, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Vous êtes heureux quand on vous insulte, qu’on vous persécute et qu’on répand sur vous toutes sortes de mensonges malveillants à cause de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Vous êtes heureux quand les gens disent du mal de vous, quand ils vous font souffrir et racontent des mensonges sur vous parce que vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suivez.

sw.L: Heri ninyi watakapowatukana na kuwatesa, na kusema kila [neno] baya dhidi yenu, wakisema uongo, kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Heri yenu watu wanapowatukana, wanapowatesa, na kueneza kila aina ya uongo mbaya juu yenu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Mmebarikiwa watu wanapowasema vibaya, wanapowaumiza na kuwasingizia uongo kwa sababu mnanifuata.

ko.L: 사람들이 나 때문에 너희를 모욕하고 박해하고, 거짓으로 너희를 거슬러 온갖 악한 [말을] 할 때, 너희는 복이 있다.
ko.B: 사람들이 나 때문에 너희를 모욕하고 박해하며, 너희에 대해 온갖 악한 거짓말을 퍼뜨릴 때, 너희는 복이 있다.
ko.R: 너희가 나를 따른다는 이유로 사람들이 너희를 욕하고 괴롭히고, 너희에 대해 거짓말을 할 때, 너희는 복이 있다.

vi.L: Phước cho các con khi người ta sỉ nhục các con, bắt bớ [các con], và vì cớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà nói dối đủ mọi điều ác chống lại các con.
vi.B: Phước cho các con khi người ta vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà sỉ nhục, bắt bớ các con và vu khống các con đủ mọi điều xấu xa.
vi.R: Phước cho các con khi người ta nói xấu các con, làm hại các con và nói dối về các con, vì các con theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

pt.L: Bem-aventurados são vocês quando os insultarem e [os] perseguirem e disserem todo [tipo de] mal contra vocês, mentindo, por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.B: Vocês são bem-aventurados quando os ofenderem e os perseguirem e espalharem todo tipo de mentira maldosa contra vocês por {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} causa.
pt.R: Vocês são felizes quando as pessoas falam mal de vocês, maltratam vocês e contam mentiras sobre vocês porque vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguem.

am.L: የተባረካችሁ ናችሁ፣ ሲነቅፏችሁና ሲያሳድዷችሁ፣ ስለ እኔም ክፉውን ሁሉ በሐሰት ሲናገሩባችሁ።
am.B: ሰዎች ስለ እኔ ብለው ሲሰድቧችሁ፣ ሲያሳድዷችሁና ልዩ ልዩ ክፉ ነገር በሐሰት ሲያወሩባችሁ የተባረካችሁ ናችሁ።
am.R: ሰዎች እኔን ስለምትከተሉ ክፉ ነገር ሲናገሩባችሁ፣ ሲጎዷችሁና ውሸት ሲያወሩባችሁ የተባረካችሁ ናችሁ።

decisions.choice: blessed are you: Jesus now speaks to his hearers directly
alternatives: a ninth blessing like the others
decisions.reason: The sayings change from "those who" to "you", and the cause becomes loyalty to Jesus.

decisions.choice: lying: what they say about you is false
decisions.reason: The word limits the blessing: it is for those who are slandered falsely.

decisions.choice: because you follow me
decisions.reason: Readable says why they are treated this way.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} forms
decisions.reason: Jesus now speaks to his hearers directly (meaning decision m1), so from here every plural "you", pronoun or verb, is the plural_you setting: ustedes by default, vosotros as the alternative.

decisions.choice: Jesus calls his hearers "các con" through the sermon, and "con" where he speaks to one person (5:23-26, 5:29-30, 5:36, 5:39-42)
decisions.reason: The style guide and the settled Matthew choices have Jesus speak to his disciples as "các con"; the crowd also listens (the meaning decision on 5:1), but the sayings are addressed to those who follow him. The singular "con" follows Mark 9:43.

decisions.choice: Jesus speaks to his hearers in 해라체 with "너희", through the Sermon on the Mount
decisions.reason: As docs/korean-style.md section 4: Jesus teaching disciples and crowds speaks in 해라체, and Readable keeps it with plainer words.

decisions.choice: maltratam vocês
decisions.reason: Readable puts "vocês" after the verb, as Brazilians say it, so that the object is plain; Literal and Balanced keep the written clitic "os".

source.text: χαίρετε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε, ὅτι ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς· οὕτως γὰρ ἐδίωξαν τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς πρὸ ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Rejoice and be glad, for the reward of you [is] great in the heavens; thus for they persecuted the prophets the before you.

en.L: Rejoice and be glad, for your reward [is] great in the heavens, for in this way they persecuted the prophets who [were] before you.
en.B: Rejoice and celebrate, because a great reward is waiting for you in heaven. That is how they persecuted the prophets who came before you.
en.R: Be happy and celebrate! You will have a great reward in heaven. People treated the prophets who lived before you in the same way.

es.L: {{plural_you:Alégrense|Alegraos}} y {{plural_you:regocíjense|regocijaos}}, porque {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} recompensa [es] grande en los cielos; pues de esta manera persiguieron a los profetas anteriores a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Alégrense|Alegraos}} y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} fiesta, porque {{plural_you:les|os}} espera una gran recompensa en el cielo. Así persiguieron a los profetas que vinieron antes que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} contentos y {{plural_you:celebren|celebrad}}! {{plural_you:Tendrán|Tendréis}} una gran recompensa en el cielo. La gente trató de la misma manera a los profetas que vivieron antes que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Réjouissez-vous et exultez, car votre récompense [est] grande dans les cieux ; car ainsi ils ont persécuté les prophètes qui [étaient] avant vous.
fr.B: Réjouissez-vous, débordez de joie, car une grande récompense vous attend dans le ciel. Les prophètes venus avant vous ont été persécutés de la même façon.
fr.R: Soyez contents et faites la fête ! Vous aurez une grande récompense dans le ciel. Les gens ont traité de la même façon les prophètes qui ont vécu avant vous.

sw.L: Furahini na mshangilie, kwa sababu thawabu yenu [ni] kubwa mbinguni; kwa maana hivyo ndivyo walivyowatesa manabii waliowatangulia.
sw.B: Furahini na msherehekee, kwa sababu thawabu kubwa inawangoja mbinguni. Ndivyo walivyowatesa manabii waliokuja kabla yenu.
sw.R: Furahini na msherehekee! Mtapata thawabu kubwa mbinguni. Watu waliwatendea vivyo hivyo manabii walioishi kabla yenu.

ko.L: 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라. 하늘들에서 너희의 상이 크기 때문이다. 너희보다 먼저 있던 예언자들을 그들이 이렇게 박해하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라. 하늘에서 너희가 받을 상이 크다. 너희보다 먼저 온 예언자들도 사람들이 이렇게 박해하였다.
ko.R: 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라! 너희는 하늘에서 큰 상을 받을 것이다. 너희보다 먼저 살았던 예언자들도 사람들에게 똑같이 괴롭힘을 당했다.

vi.L: Hãy vui mừng và hớn hở, vì phần thưởng của các con ở trên các tầng trời thật lớn; vì người ta cũng đã bắt bớ các nhà tiên tri trước các con như vậy.
vi.B: Hãy vui mừng và hân hoan, vì phần thưởng lớn lao đang chờ các con ở trên trời. Người ta cũng đã bắt bớ các nhà tiên tri trước các con như thế.
vi.R: Hãy vui mừng và hớn hở! Các con sẽ có phần thưởng lớn ở trên trời. Người ta cũng đã đối xử với các nhà tiên tri sống trước các con như vậy.

pt.L: Alegrem-se e exultem, porque a recompensa de vocês [é] grande nos céus, pois assim perseguiram os profetas que [foram] antes de vocês.
pt.B: Alegrem-se e festejem, porque uma grande recompensa espera por vocês no céu. Foi assim que perseguiram os profetas que vieram antes de vocês.
pt.R: Fiquem felizes e comemorem! Vocês vão receber uma grande recompensa no céu. As pessoas trataram do mesmo jeito os profetas que viveram antes de vocês.

am.L: ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ ሐሤትም አድርጉ፤ ዋጋችሁ በሰማያት ታላቅ ነውና፤ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩትን ነቢያት እንዲሁ አሳድደዋቸዋልና።
am.B: ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ በደስታም ፈንጥዙ፤ በሰማይ ታላቅ ዋጋ ይጠብቃችኋልና። ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩትን ነቢያትም ያሳደዷቸው በዚሁ መንገድ ነበር።
am.R: ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ እልል በሉ! በሰማይ ታላቅ ዋጋ ታገኛላችሁ። ከእናንተ በፊት የኖሩትን ነቢያትም ሰዎች እንዲሁ አድርገውባቸዋል።

decisions.choice: your reward in heaven: what God has kept for you
decisions.reason: Heaven here is where God keeps what he will give (6:20). The reward is his gift, not wages.

decisions.choice: the prophets before you: those whom Israel rejected and persecuted
decisions.reason: Jeremiah was beaten and imprisoned (Jeremiah 20:2; 37:15); Jesus later speaks of the killing of prophets (23:29-37). The disciples stand in their line.

decisions.choice: "trên các tầng trời" (L); "trên trời" (B, R) for "in the heavens"
decisions.reason: The settled Matthew choice for the Father "in the heavens" (5:16), used here too: Literal shows the Greek plural, as Mark 1:10 does, and Balanced and Readable say "trên trời".

decisions.choice: "하늘들" (L), "하늘" (B, R) for the Greek plural "heavens", through Matthew 5
decisions.reason: Literal shows the Greek plural, as the Korean Mark does; Korean otherwise speaks of heaven in the singular.

decisions.choice: a recompensa de vocês (L); uma grande recompensa espera por vocês (B, R)
decisions.reason: With "vocês", "sua" could mean "his", "her" or "their" as well as "your". Portuguese says "de vocês" where the owner must be clear, which is how Brazilians speak and write it.

decisions.choice: ዋጋ (reward)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a wage or reward. "ዋጋ" is the pay a worker earns and also what God gives, as the Greek word is; "ሽልማት" suggests a prize won in a contest. The same word is used through the book (5:46; 6:1-16; 10:41-42).

source.text: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ ἅλας τῆς γῆς· ἐὰν δὲ τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ, ἐν τίνι ἁλισθήσεται;

records.literal_gloss: You are the salt of the earth; if but the salt becomes tasteless, with what will it be salted?

en.L: You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt becomes tasteless, with what will it be made salty?
en.B: You are the salt for the earth. But if salt goes flat, what can give it back its saltiness?
en.R: You are like salt for all the people on earth. But if salt loses its taste, there is no way to make it salty again.

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} la sal de la tierra; pero si la sal se vuelve insípida, ¿con qué se la salará?
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} la sal para la tierra. Pero si la sal pierde su sabor, ¿qué podrá devolverle lo salado?
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} como sal para toda la gente de la tierra. Pero si la sal pierde su sabor, no hay manera de que vuelva a ser salada.

fr.L: Vous êtes le sel de la terre ; mais si le sel devient fade, avec quoi sera-t-il salé ?
fr.B: Vous êtes le sel pour la terre. Mais si le sel perd sa saveur, qu’est-ce qui pourra lui rendre son goût salé ?
fr.R: Vous êtes comme du sel pour tous les gens de la terre. Mais si le sel perd son goût, il n’y a aucun moyen de le rendre salé à nouveau.

sw.L: Ninyi ni chumvi ya dunia; lakini chumvi ikiisha kupoteza ladha yake, itarudishiwa uchumvi wake kwa kitu gani?
sw.B: Ninyi ni chumvi kwa ajili ya dunia. Lakini chumvi ikipoteza ladha yake, ni nini kitakachoirudishia uchumvi wake?
sw.R: Ninyi ni kama chumvi kwa watu wote duniani. Lakini chumvi ikipoteza ladha yake, hakuna njia ya kuifanya iwe na chumvi tena.

ko.L: 너희는 땅의 소금이다. 그러나 소금이 맛을 잃으면, 무엇으로 그것을 짜게 하겠느냐?
ko.B: 너희는 땅의 소금이다. 그러나 소금이 짠맛을 잃으면, 무엇으로 다시 짜게 하겠느냐?
ko.R: 너희는 온 땅의 사람들에게 소금과 같다. 그러나 소금이 짠맛을 잃으면, 다시 짜게 할 방법이 없다.

vi.L: Các con là muối của đất; nhưng nếu muối trở nên nhạt, thì lấy gì làm cho nó mặn lại?
vi.B: Các con là muối cho trái đất. Nhưng nếu muối bị nhạt đi, thì lấy gì làm cho nó mặn lại?
vi.R: Các con giống như muối cho mọi người trên trái đất. Nhưng nếu muối mất vị mặn, thì không có cách nào làm cho nó mặn lại được.

pt.L: Vocês são o sal da terra; mas, se o sal perder o sabor, com que será salgado?
pt.B: Vocês são o sal da terra. Mas, se o sal perder o sabor, o que poderá devolver o seu gosto salgado?
pt.R: Vocês são como o sal para todas as pessoas da terra. Mas, se o sal perder o gosto, não há como torná-lo salgado de novo.

am.L: እናንተ የምድር ጨው ናችሁ፤ ጨው ግን ጣዕሙ ቢጠፋ በምን ጨዋማ ይደረጋል?
am.B: እናንተ ለምድር ጨው ናችሁ። ጨው ግን ጣዕሙን ቢያጣ ጨዋማነቱን ምን ሊመልስለት ይችላል?
am.R: እናንተ በምድር ላይ ላሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ እንደ ጨው ናችሁ። ጨው ግን ጣዕሙን ካጣ እንደገና ጨዋማ የሚያደርገው ምንም ነገር የለም።

decisions.choice: salt: what gives flavor and keeps food from spoiling
decisions.reason: Salt seasoned food and preserved it. The disciples are what the world needs in order to be what God wants.

decisions.choice: becomes tasteless: loses its saltiness
decisions.reason: The verb can mean "be foolish" or "become tasteless". Salt from the Dead Sea was mixed with other minerals, and the salt could leach out, leaving something that looked like salt but had no taste.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
alternatives: with what will it be salted?
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "nothing". Readable gives the answer.

source.text: εἰς οὐδὲν ἰσχύει ἔτι εἰ μὴ βληθὲν ἔξω καταπατεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

records.literal_gloss: For nothing it is strong any longer except having been thrown out to be trampled by the men.

en.L: It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by {{gender:people|men}}.
en.B: It is good for nothing anymore but to be thrown out and walked on.
en.R: It is not good for anything. It gets thrown out, and people walk on it.

es.L: Ya no sirve para nada, sino para ser arrojada fuera y pisoteada por {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}.
es.B: Ya no sirve para nada, sino para tirarla afuera y que la pisen.
es.R: No sirve para nada. Se tira afuera y la gente la pisa.

fr.L: Il n’est plus bon à rien, sinon à être jeté dehors et piétiné par les {{gender:gens|hommes}}.
fr.B: Il n’est plus bon à rien qu’à être jeté dehors et piétiné.
fr.R: Il n’est plus bon à rien. On le jette dehors, et les gens marchent dessus.

sw.L: Haina nguvu tena kwa lolote, ila kutupwa nje ili ikanyagwe na watu.
sw.B: Haifai tena kwa chochote ila kutupwa nje na kukanyagwa.
sw.R: Haifai kwa kitu chochote. Hutupwa nje, nao watu huikanyaga.

ko.L: 그것은 더 이상 아무 데도 쓸모가 없어서, 밖에 버려져 사람들에게 밟힐 뿐이다.
ko.B: 그런 소금은 더 이상 아무 쓸모가 없어서, 밖에 내버려져 사람들의 발에 밟힐 뿐이다.
ko.R: 그런 소금은 아무 데도 쓸 데가 없다. 밖에 버려지고, 사람들이 그 위를 밟고 다닌다.

vi.L: Nó không còn dùng được vào việc gì nữa, ngoại trừ bị ném ra ngoài và bị người ta giẫm đạp.
vi.B: Nó chẳng còn ích gì nữa, chỉ đáng bị ném ra ngoài cho người ta giẫm lên.
vi.R: Nó không còn dùng được vào việc gì. Người ta ném nó ra ngoài và giẫm lên nó.

pt.L: Já não serve para nada, a não ser para ser jogado fora e pisado {{gender:pelas pessoas|pelos homens}}.
pt.B: Não serve mais para nada, senão para ser jogado fora e pisado.
pt.R: Ele não serve para nada. É jogado fora, e as pessoas pisam nele.

am.L: ከእንግዲህ ለምንም ብቃት የለውም፤ ወደ ውጭ ተጥሎ በሰዎች እንዲረገጥ ካልሆነ በቀር።
am.B: ከዚያ በኋላ ወደ ውጭ ተጥሎ ከመረገጥ በስተቀር ምንም ጥቅም የለውም።
am.R: ለምንም አይጠቅምም። ወደ ውጭ ይጣላል፤ ሰዎችም ይረግጡታል።

decisions.choice: thrown out and trampled: a warning of judgment
decisions.reason: Being thrown out is a picture of rejection at the judgment (8:12; 13:48). Disciples who lose what makes them disciples are useless.

decisions.choice: {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}
decisions.reason: Spanish has the same two wordings as English here, "los hombres" in the older sense of human beings or "la gente", so Literal keeps the gender setting, as in 5:16.

decisions.choice: les {{gender:gens|hommes}} for the plural of the word for human beings, in this sermon (5:13, 5:16)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 6:22: the word means people in general, and "les gens" is the natural inclusive French for that; "les humains" would sound as if humanity were set against something else. The traditional "les hommes" is the alternative.

decisions.choice: watu, no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Watu" already means people, men and women; "wanaume" would mean males only, so Swahili has no gender span here or in 5:16.

decisions.choice: "người ta" with no gender span (L)
decisions.reason: "Người ta" already means everyone, men and women; the English traditional "men" has no Vietnamese counterpart with the same sense. The same in 5:16 and 5:19.

decisions.choice: "사람들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already includes men and women, so the English setting has nothing to change here.

source.text: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου.

records.literal_gloss: You are the light of the world.

en.L: You are the light of the world.
en.B: You are the light of the world.
en.R: You are like a light for the whole world.

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} la luz del mundo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} la luz del mundo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} como una luz para todo el mundo.

fr.L: Vous êtes la lumière du monde.
fr.B: Vous êtes la lumière du monde.
fr.R: Vous êtes comme une lumière pour le monde entier.

sw.R: Ninyi ni kama nuru kwa ulimwengu wote.

ko.R: 너희는 온 세상을 비추는 빛과 같다.

vi.L: Các con là ánh sáng của thế gian.
vi.B: Các con là ánh sáng của thế gian.
vi.R: Các con giống như ánh sáng cho cả thế gian.

pt.L: Vocês são a luz do mundo.
pt.B: Vocês são a luz do mundo.
pt.R: Vocês são como uma luz para o mundo inteiro.

am.R: እናንተ ለዓለም ሁሉ እንደ ብርሃን ናችሁ።

decisions.choice: the light of the world: Israel's calling to be a light to the nations
decisions.reason: God called his servant to be "a light for the nations" (Isaiah 42:6; 49:6). Jesus gives that calling to his disciples. In 4:16 Jesus himself is the light.

source.text: οὐ δύναται πόλις κρυβῆναι ἐπάνω ὄρους κειμένη·

records.literal_gloss: Not is able a city to be hidden on a hill lying;

en.L: A city lying on a hill cannot be hidden.
en.B: A town built on a hilltop cannot be hidden.
en.R: Everyone can see a town that is built on top of a hill.

es.L: No puede ocultarse una ciudad situada sobre un monte.
es.B: Un pueblo construido en lo alto de un cerro no se puede esconder.
es.R: Todos pueden ver un pueblo que está construido en lo alto de una colina.

fr.L: Une ville située sur une colline ne peut pas être cachée.
fr.B: On ne peut cacher une ville bâtie au sommet d’une colline.
fr.R: Tout le monde peut voir une ville construite en haut d’une colline.

sw.L: Mji ulio juu ya kilima hauwezi kufichwa.
sw.B: Mji uliojengwa juu ya kilima hauwezi kufichika.
sw.R: Kila mtu anaweza kuuona mji uliojengwa juu ya kilima.

ko.L: 산 위에 놓인 도시는 숨겨질 수 없다.
ko.B: 산 위에 세운 마을은 숨길 수 없다.
ko.R: 산꼭대기에 세운 마을은 누구나 볼 수 있다.

vi.L: Một thành ở trên núi không thể bị che khuất được.
vi.B: Một thành xây trên đỉnh đồi thì không thể che giấu được.
vi.R: Ai cũng thấy được một thị trấn xây trên đỉnh đồi.

pt.L: Não pode uma cidade ser escondida, situada sobre um monte;
pt.B: Uma cidade construída no alto de um monte não pode ficar escondida.
pt.R: Todo mundo consegue ver uma cidade construída no alto de um monte.

am.L: በተራራ ላይ የተቀመጠች ከተማ ልትሰወር አትችልም።
am.B: በኮረብታ ጫፍ ላይ የተሠራች ከተማ ልትደበቅ አትችልም።
am.R: በኮረብታ አናት ላይ የተሠራችን ከተማ ሰው ሁሉ ያያታል።

decisions.choice: a city on a hill: seen from far away
decisions.reason: Towns were often built on hills and their white walls could be seen for miles. Some hear an echo of Jerusalem on Mount Zion (Isaiah 2:2-3).

decisions.choice: everyone can see
decisions.reason: Readable says it positively.

source.text: οὐδὲ καίουσιν λύχνον καὶ τιθέασιν αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν, καὶ λάμπει πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: Nor do they light a lamp and put it under the basket, but on the lampstand, and it shines to all the in the house.

en.L: Nor do they light a lamp and put it under the basket, but on the lampstand, and it shines for all who [are] in the house.
en.B: No one lights a lamp and hides it under a basket; it goes on a lampstand, where it shines for everyone in the house.
en.R: People do not light a lamp and then cover it with a bowl. They put it up high on a stand, so it gives light to everyone in the house.

es.L: Ni encienden una lámpara y la ponen debajo del cesto, sino sobre el candelero, y alumbra a todos los que [están] en la casa.
es.B: Nadie enciende una lámpara para esconderla debajo de un cesto; se pone sobre el candelero, y desde allí alumbra a todos los de la casa.
es.R: La gente no enciende una lámpara para luego taparla con un recipiente. La pone arriba, en un soporte, y así alumbra a todos los que están en la casa.

fr.L: Et on n’allume pas non plus une lampe pour la mettre sous le boisseau, mais sur le porte-lampe, et elle brille pour tous ceux qui [sont] dans la maison.
fr.B: Personne n’allume une lampe pour la cacher sous un récipient ; on la pose sur son support, et elle éclaire tous ceux qui sont dans la maison.
fr.R: Les gens n’allument pas une lampe pour la couvrir ensuite avec un seau. Ils la posent en hauteur sur un support, et elle éclaire tout le monde dans la maison.

sw.L: Wala hawawashi taa na kuiweka chini ya kikapu, bali juu ya kinara chake, nayo inawaangazia wote waliomo ndani ya nyumba.
sw.B: Hakuna mtu anayewasha taa na kuificha chini ya kikapu; huiweka juu ya kinara, nayo huwaangazia wote walio nyumbani.
sw.R: Watu hawawashi taa kisha kuifunika kwa bakuli. Huiweka juu kwenye kinara, ili iwaangazie wote walio ndani ya nyumba.

ko.L: 또 사람들은 등불을 켜서 말 아래에 두지 않고 등잔대 위에 둔다. 그러면 그것이 집 안에 있는 모든 사람에게 비친다.
ko.B: 등불을 켜서 말 아래에 두는 사람은 없다. 등잔대 위에 두어서 집 안에 있는 모든 사람을 비추게 한다.
ko.R: 사람들은 등불을 켜서 그릇으로 덮어 두지 않는다. 등불을 높은 받침대 위에 올려놓아서 집 안에 있는 모든 사람에게 빛을 비춘다.

vi.L: Người ta cũng không thắp đèn rồi để dưới cái đấu, nhưng [đặt] trên chân đèn, và nó soi sáng cho mọi người ở trong nhà.
vi.B: Không ai thắp đèn rồi lấy thúng úp lại, nhưng đặt trên chân đèn, để đèn soi sáng cho mọi người trong nhà.
vi.R: Người ta không thắp đèn rồi lấy cái thúng úp lên. Họ đặt đèn lên cao trên chân đèn, để nó soi sáng cho mọi người trong nhà.

pt.L: Nem acendem uma candeia e a colocam debaixo do cesto, mas sobre o candelabro, e ela ilumina todos os que [estão] na casa.
pt.B: Ninguém acende uma candeia para escondê-la debaixo de um cesto; ela é posta no candelabro, onde ilumina todos os que estão na casa.
pt.R: Ninguém acende uma lamparina e depois a cobre com uma vasilha. Ela é colocada no alto, num suporte, para iluminar todos os que estão na casa.

am.L: መብራትንም አብርተው ከእህል መስፈሪያ በታች አያኖሩትም፤ ይልቁንም በመቅረዝ ላይ [ያኖሩታል]፤ በቤቱ ውስጥ ላሉት ሁሉም ያበራል።
am.B: ማንም መብራት አብርቶ ከመስፈሪያ በታች አይደብቀውም፤ በመቅረዝ ላይ ይቀመጣል እንጂ፤ በዚያም በቤት ውስጥ ላሉት ሁሉ ያበራል።
am.R: ሰዎች መብራት አብርተው በሳህን አይሸፍኑትም። ከፍ ባለ መቆሚያ ላይ ያስቀምጡታል፤ በዚህም በቤት ውስጥ ላሉት ሁሉ ብርሃን ይሰጣል።

decisions.choice: a lamp under the basket: a small clay oil lamp and a grain measure
decisions.reason: Houses had one room and a small oil lamp. The basket was a measure for grain that held about two gallons; put over the lamp, it would hide the light or put it out.

decisions.choice: No one (B); People (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek "they" means people in general.

decisions.choice: a bowl
decisions.reason: Readable names a common container.

decisions.choice: le boisseau (L); un récipient (B); un seau (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:21: the Greek names a grain measure (m1), which French has long called "boisseau", and "mettre sous le boisseau" is still a French idiom for hiding something; Literal keeps it. Balanced and Readable use a common container, the same words as Mark.

decisions.choice: "cái đấu" (L); "cái thúng" (B, R) for the grain measure
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:21: "đấu" is the Vietnamese grain measure, and "thúng" is the everyday basket a reader can picture covering a lamp. The English Readable says "bowl".
The Greek word is a vessel for measuring grain (meaning decision); the Korean "말" is the same kind of measure, so the picture carries over. Readable says simply a bowl, as the English does.

decisions.choice: candeia, candelabro (L, B); lamparina, suporte (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book. A Brazilian "lâmpada" is an electric bulb, so Literal and Balanced say "candeia", a small oil lamp, on its "candelabro" (stand); Readable says "lamparina", the oil lamp still known in the countryside, on a "suporte".

decisions.choice: Ninguém
decisions.reason: As the English: the Greek "they" means people in general. Readable says "Ninguém" too, which is how Portuguese puts the general case.

decisions.choice: የእህል መስፈሪያ, መስፈሪያ (a grain measure, L, B); ሳህን (a bowl, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a vessel for measuring grain, which a lamp could be hidden under. "መስፈሪያ" names it; Readable uses a bowl, as the English Readable does.

source.text: οὕτως λαμψάτω τὸ φῶς ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὅπως ἴδωσιν ὑμῶν τὰ καλὰ ἔργα καὶ δοξάσωσιν τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν τὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: Thus let shine the light of you before the men, so that they may see of you the good works and may glorify the Father of you the in the heavens.

en.L: In the same way let your light shine before {{gender:people|men}}, so that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who [is] in the heavens.
en.B: In the same way, your light must shine where people can see it, so that they will see your good deeds and give glory to your Father in heaven.
en.R: In the same way, let your light shine for people to see. Then they will see the good things you do, and they will give glory to your Father in heaven.

es.L: De este modo resplandezca {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} luz ante {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}, de manera que vean {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} obras buenas y den gloria a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre, el [que está] en los cielos.
es.B: Del mismo modo, {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} luz debe brillar donde la gente pueda verla, para que vean {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} buenas acciones y den gloria a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre que está en el cielo.
es.R: De la misma manera, {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} que {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} luz brille para que la gente la vea. Así verán el bien que {{plural_you:ustedes hacen|hacéis}}, y darán gloria a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre que está en el cielo.

fr.L: De même, que votre lumière brille devant les {{gender:gens|hommes}}, afin qu’ils voient vos bonnes œuvres et qu’ils glorifient votre Père qui [est] dans les cieux.
fr.B: De la même manière, votre lumière doit briller là où les gens peuvent la voir, afin qu’ils voient le bien que vous faites et rendent gloire à votre Père qui est dans le ciel.
fr.R: De la même façon, faites briller votre lumière pour que les gens la voient. Alors ils verront le bien que vous faites, et ils rendront gloire à votre Père qui est dans le ciel.

sw.L: Hivyo nuru yenu na ing'ae mbele ya watu, ili waone kazi zenu nzuri na kumpa utukufu Baba yenu aliye mbinguni.
sw.B: Vilevile, nuru yenu inapaswa kung'aa mahali ambapo watu wanaweza kuiona, ili waone matendo yenu mazuri na kumtukuza Baba yenu wa mbinguni.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, acheni nuru yenu iangaze ili watu waione. Ndipo watakapoyaona mambo mema mnayoyafanya, nao watamtukuza Baba yenu aliye mbinguni.

ko.L: 이와 같이 너희의 빛이 사람들 앞에 비치게 하여라. 그래서 그들이 너희의 선한 행실을 보고, 하늘들에 계신 너희 아버지께 영광을 돌리게 하여라.
ko.B: 이와 같이 너희 빛이 사람들 앞에 비치게 하여라. 그러면 그들이 너희의 선한 행실을 보고 하늘에 계신 너희 아버지께 영광을 돌릴 것이다.
ko.R: 너희도 이처럼 너희의 빛을 사람들 앞에 비추어라. 그러면 사람들이 너희가 하는 좋은 일들을 보고, 하늘에 계신 너희 아버지께 영광을 돌릴 것이다.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, hãy để ánh sáng của các con chiếu sáng trước mặt người ta, để họ thấy những việc lành của các con và tôn vinh Cha các con, Đấng ở trên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Cũng vậy, ánh sáng của các con phải chiếu sáng trước mặt mọi người, để họ thấy những việc tốt lành các con làm và tôn vinh Cha các con ở trên trời.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, hãy để ánh sáng của các con chiếu sáng cho người ta thấy. Rồi họ sẽ thấy những việc tốt các con làm, và họ sẽ tôn vinh Cha các con ở trên trời.

pt.L: Assim brilhe a luz de vocês diante {{gender:das pessoas|dos homens}}, para que vejam as boas obras de vocês e glorifiquem o Pai de vocês que [está] nos céus.
pt.B: Do mesmo modo, a luz de vocês deve brilhar diante das pessoas, para que vejam as boas obras que vocês fazem e deem glória ao Pai de vocês, que está no céu.
pt.R: Do mesmo jeito, deixem a luz de vocês brilhar para as pessoas verem. Assim elas vão ver o bem que vocês fazem e vão dar glória ao Pai de vocês, que está no céu.

am.L: እንዲሁ ብርሃናችሁ በሰዎች ፊት ይብራ፤ ይኸውም መልካም ሥራዎቻችሁን እንዲያዩና በሰማያት ያለውን አባታችሁን እንዲያከብሩ ነው።
am.B: እንደዚሁም ብርሃናችሁ ሰዎች በሚያዩበት ይብራ፤ ይህም መልካም ሥራችሁን አይተው በሰማይ ላለው አባታችሁ ክብር እንዲሰጡ ነው።
am.R: እንደዚሁም ሰዎች እንዲያዩት ብርሃናችሁ ይብራ። በዚያን ጊዜ የምታደርጉትን መልካም ነገር ያያሉ፤ በሰማይ ላለው አባታችሁም ክብር ይሰጣሉ።

decisions.choice: so that they glorify your Father: the good deeds point people to God
alternatives: so that the disciples are praised
decisions.reason: The aim is God's honor, not the disciples' (6:1). The Father in heaven is a name for God that Matthew uses often.

decisions.choice: good works: deeds of mercy and obedience that others can see
decisions.reason: The phrase covers the whole of a life lived as 5:3-12 describes.

decisions.choice: give glory to
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the noun form, which keeps the key term.

decisions.choice: "Cha các con, Đấng ở trên các tầng trời" (L); "Cha các con ở trên trời" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled form for the Father "in the heavens" through Matthew. "Cha" is a noun, always capitalised, and takes no deity_pronoun span (as in Mark 11:25).

decisions.choice: "tôn vinh" for glorify
decisions.reason: The key term with "vinh quang" (style guide, section 5); the English Balanced "give glory to" says the same.

decisions.choice: "하늘들에 계신 너희 아버지" (L); "하늘에 계신 너희 아버지" (B, R), through Matthew
decisions.reason: God is honored with "계신" and "께"; Literal keeps the Greek plural "heavens" as elsewhere in Matthew 5. "영광" is the key term at every level.

decisions.choice: o Pai de vocês
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "de vocês" makes plain whose Father is meant, where "seu Pai" could be read as "his Father"; "vosso" is not used (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4).
